Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the establishment year of the American League as potentially being 1900 instead of 1901, despite the question explicitly asking for the year the league was "established." While credible sources consistently cite 1901 as the year the American League achieved major league status and was formally established, the Planner introduced unnecessary ambiguity by considering 1900 (the year the Western League was renamed). This led to repeated and redundant searches that delayed arriving at the correct and straightforward answer of 1901.
